title: Connect to mobile network using mmcli
summary: Use the mmcli command-line tool to connect your modem to the mobile network. You need to know your ISP's APN (Access Point Name).
prerequisites: You know your ISP's APN (e.g., 'internet', 'm2m.com', etc.).

steps.explain: List available modems to find the modem index (e.g., /org/freedesktop/ModemManager1/Modem/0).
Connect to the network using the modem index and your APN. Replace <MODEM_INDEX> with the number found in the previous step (e.g., 0) and <APN> with your ISP's APN.

placeholders.name: MODEM_INDEX
placeholders.description: The index of the modem, e.g., 0

placeholders.name: APN
placeholders.description: Access Point Name provided by your ISP
